items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: The interviewee describes Kid Renai as 'Lewis Lonezhong's right hand man' and discusses his death and drinking, but does not claim a direct personal interaction or professional collaboration with Renai himself.

ctx.x: He was one of the sweetest trumpet players you always have a poor them. With them. When he put them mute them there. Sweetest mute them the trumpet them. He was Lewis Lonezhong's right hand man. Lewis tried them them away over them. Oh really? A many times when his wife didn't want him to go.
So he, Kid Renai never left him alone.
No he died again. Yeah he died.
